name: How long does a typical roof vent assessment take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical roof vent assessment take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a roof vent assessment varies depending on the size and complexity of your roof and attic space, but typically, it can be completed within 30 to 60 minutes. This includes a visual inspection from the exterior and often an internal check of the attic space. Process clarity: Our technicians aim to provide a swift yet thorough inspection, allowing us to accurately diagnose any issues and discuss potential solutions without significant disruption to your day.
acceptedAnswer.description: A roof vent assessment usually takes 30-60 minutes, depending on roof size and complexity, ensuring a thorough inspection with minimal disruption.
